column4: Own the current mesh-home routing substrate under docs/coordination.md. Prove the exact connected 100.74.0.0/16 LAN route, table-52 precedence, current tailnet /32 routes, and rollback; coordinate holds, claim the route in mesh-trace, arm mesh-dms, install only the narrow verified throw needed to restore 100.74.0.1 to enp42s0, and cancel the dead-man switch only after ip route get 100.74.0.1, mesh-health, mesh-card --refresh, egress, and tailnet reachability verify. Preserve an explicit failure artifact if collision or safety checks refuse the write.

After the live route and exact safety contract are evidenced, update scripts/mesh-exit-node-lan-heal so a locally connected RFC6598/CGNAT LAN prefix can be restored without allowing arbitrary public prefixes. Bind acceptance to live connected-route evidence and preserve more-specific Tailscale peer routes; add regression fixtures for accepted connected CGNAT, rejected unconnected/public prefixes, peer overlap precedence, idempotence, and loud refusal. Land the focused source and tests with a receipt.

Deploy the landed healer through the checked manifest path, verify deployed/source identity and actual reflex wiring, exercise an isolated safe re-apply path under single-writer coordination, and prove the gateway, egress, LAN, and tailnet routes remain correct. Record rollback and any honest unavailable arm.

Independently verify the completed live and recurring repair using ip route get 100.74.0.1, mesh-card --refresh, mesh-health, current table 52, healer/reflex freshness, and the source/deployed hash. Close only with a durable receipt or reject/block with the exact remaining failure.
